/-
Investigation only: replace emitted ordinary MAY/ANY initials with STAR.
No implementation or semantic selection follows from this model.

Scope: FULL scalar marks, ordinary bases, ANY demands, Empty E, all accessors
counted fields, restricted runs >=2. Current budgeted scalar emission is reused.
A direction filter models backward MUST rejection. ANY-demand cells do not use
the imported run-2 STAR-demand override. Static/GROUP/ND/aliases/mx/H and nonempty
E require separate native adapters. ZERO is a separate typed token, not base 0.

The image proof has constructive current-emitter witnesses. C5 below models its
entry image+insideDemand gate and FLOW EXACT normalized preimage, not complete
exit restriction, matching, state transition, convergence or global soundness.
-/
import RestrictedInitialPolicy

namespace MayInitialToStarAudit
open ApSpec
abbrev Input := RestrictedInitialPolicy.Input
abbrev Mark := RestrictedInitialPolicy.Mark

inductive Direction where | forward | backward
deriving DecidableEq, Repr
inductive Layer where | normal | demand
deriving DecidableEq, Repr
structure Mode where
  direction : Direction
  fieldLimit : Nat
deriving DecidableEq, Repr
structure AnyDemand where
  base : Nat
  path : List Acc
  mark : Mark
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def asDemand (d : AnyDemand) : RestrictedInitialPolicy.Demand :=
  ⟨d.base,d.path,.any,d.mark⟩
def directionLegal (direction : Direction) (initial : Input) : Bool :=
  match direction with | .forward => true | .backward => !initial.must

def currentEmit (mode : Mode) (d : AnyDemand) (actual : Input) : Option Input :=
  match RestrictedInitialPolicy.DemandStarPolicy.emitAtBudget mode.fieldLimit (asDemand d) actual with
  | none => none
  | some initial => if directionLegal mode.direction initial then some initial else none

def currentCanEmit (mode : Mode) (d : AnyDemand) (initial : Input) : Bool :=
  RestrictedInitialPolicy.DemandStarPolicy.canEmitAtBudget mode.fieldLimit (asDemand d) initial &&
    directionLegal mode.direction initial

theorem ANY_demand_never_uses_STAR_demand_override (d : AnyDemand) (actual : Input) :
    RestrictedInitialPolicy.DemandStarPolicy.overrideStar (asDemand d) actual = false := by
  simp [RestrictedInitialPolicy.DemandStarPolicy.overrideStar,asDemand,
    RestrictedInitialPolicy.shapeEq]

theorem current_image_has_constructive_actual_witness (mode : Mode) (d : AnyDemand)
    (initial : Input) :
    currentCanEmit mode d initial = true ↔ ∃ actual, currentEmit mode d actual = some initial := by
  constructor
  · intro allowed
    obtain ⟨image,legal⟩ := (Bool.and_eq_true _ _).mp allowed
    obtain ⟨actual,emitted⟩ :=
      (RestrictedInitialPolicy.DemandStarPolicy.bounded_image_has_executable_witness
        mode.fieldLimit (asDemand d) initial).mp image
    exact ⟨actual,by simp only [currentEmit,emitted,legal,if_true]⟩
  · rintro ⟨actual,emitted⟩
    cases raw : RestrictedInitialPolicy.DemandStarPolicy.emitAtBudget mode.fieldLimit (asDemand d) actual with
    | none => simp only [currentEmit,raw] at emitted; cases emitted
    | some candidate =>
      cases legal : directionLegal mode.direction candidate with
      | false => simp only [currentEmit,raw,legal,Bool.false_eq_true,if_false] at emitted; cases emitted
      | true =>
        have same : candidate = initial := by
          simpa only [currentEmit,raw,legal,if_true,Option.some.injEq] using emitted
        subst initial
        exact (Bool.and_eq_true _ _).mpr
          ⟨(RestrictedInitialPolicy.DemandStarPolicy.bounded_image_has_executable_witness
            mode.fieldLimit (asDemand d) candidate).mpr ⟨actual,raw⟩,legal⟩

/-- ANY with must=false is MAY. MUST is shape ANY with must=true and is unchanged. -/
def replaceMay (initial : Input) : Input :=
  match initial.shape, initial.must with
  | .any, false => { initial with shape := .star }
  | _, _ => initial

def isMay (initial : Input) : Bool :=
  RestrictedInitialPolicy.shapeEq initial.shape .any && !initial.must

/-- Exact finite inverse list of replacement. It is not self-projection. -/
def replacementPreimages (initial : Input) : List Input :=
  match initial.shape, initial.must with
  | .any, false => []
  | .star, false => [initial,{ initial with shape := .any }]
  | _, _ => [initial]

theorem replacement_has_explicit_preimage (initial : Input) :
    initial ∈ replacementPreimages (replaceMay initial) := by
  cases initial with
  | mk base path shape mark must =>
    cases shape <;> cases must <;> simp [replaceMay,replacementPreimages]

theorem every_listed_preimage_replaces_to_target (candidate initial : Input)
    (member : candidate ∈ replacementPreimages initial) : replaceMay candidate = initial := by
  cases initial with
  | mk base path shape mark must =>
    cases shape <;> cases must <;> simp [replacementPreimages] at member
    all_goals first
      | (subst candidate; rfl)
      | (rcases member with same | same <;> cases same <;> rfl)

def chooseCurrent (mode : Mode) (d : AnyDemand) : List Input → Bool
  | [] => false
  | initial :: rest => currentCanEmit mode d initial || chooseCurrent mode d rest

theorem choose_current_iff_explicit_candidate (mode : Mode) (d : AnyDemand) (values : List Input) :
    chooseCurrent mode d values = true ↔
      ∃ candidate, candidate ∈ values ∧ currentCanEmit mode d candidate = true := by
  induction values with
  | nil => simp [chooseCurrent]
  | cons head rest ih =>
    constructor
    · intro chosen
      change (currentCanEmit mode d head || chooseCurrent mode d rest) = true at chosen
      cases (Bool.or_eq_true _ _).mp chosen with
      | inl accepted => exact ⟨head,by simp,accepted⟩
      | inr accepted =>
        obtain ⟨candidate,member,image⟩ := ih.mp accepted
        exact ⟨candidate,List.mem_cons_of_mem head member,image⟩
    · rintro ⟨candidate,member,accepted⟩
      change (currentCanEmit mode d head || chooseCurrent mode d rest) = true
      cases List.mem_cons.mp member with
      | inl same =>
        subst candidate
        exact (Bool.or_eq_true _ _).mpr (Or.inl accepted)
      | inr member =>
        exact (Bool.or_eq_true _ _).mpr (Or.inr (ih.mpr ⟨candidate,member,accepted⟩))

def candidateEmit (mode : Mode) (d : AnyDemand) (actual : Input) : Option Input :=
  (currentEmit mode d actual).map replaceMay

def candidateCanEmit (mode : Mode) (d : AnyDemand) (initial : Input) : Bool :=
  chooseCurrent mode d (replacementPreimages initial)

/-- Complete output image of the candidate, with a current native-model actual
witness for each accepted initial. No hypothetical initial is interned. -/
theorem candidate_image_exactly_matches_emission (mode : Mode) (d : AnyDemand)
    (initial : Input) :
    candidateCanEmit mode d initial = true ↔ ∃ actual, candidateEmit mode d actual = some initial := by
  constructor
  · intro allowed
    obtain ⟨raw,member,oldImage⟩ := (choose_current_iff_explicit_candidate mode d _).mp allowed
    obtain ⟨actual,emitted⟩ := (current_image_has_constructive_actual_witness mode d raw).mp oldImage
    exact ⟨actual,by simp only [candidateEmit,emitted,Option.map_some,
      every_listed_preimage_replaces_to_target raw initial member]⟩
  · rintro ⟨actual,emitted⟩
    cases old : currentEmit mode d actual with
    | none => simp only [candidateEmit,old,Option.map_none] at emitted; cases emitted
    | some raw =>
      have same : replaceMay raw = initial := by
        simpa only [candidateEmit,old,Option.map_some,Option.some.injEq] using emitted
      apply (choose_current_iff_explicit_candidate mode d _).mpr
      refine ⟨raw,?_,(current_image_has_constructive_actual_witness mode d raw).mpr ⟨actual,old⟩⟩
      rw [← same]
      exact replacement_has_explicit_preimage raw

theorem replacement_removes_only_MAY_head (initial : Input) :
    isMay (replaceMay initial) = false := by
  cases initial with
  | mk base path shape mark must =>
    cases shape <;> cases must <;> rfl

theorem replacement_keeps_base_path_mark (initial : Input) :
    (replaceMay initial).base = initial.base ∧
    (replaceMay initial).path = initial.path ∧
    (replaceMay initial).mark = initial.mark := by
  cases initial with
  | mk base path shape mark must =>
    cases shape <;> cases must <;> exact ⟨rfl,rfl,rfl⟩

/-- Empty-E ANY-demand containment only. It is not arbitrary native matching. -/
def insideAny (d : AnyDemand) (initial : Input) : Bool :=
  Nat.beq d.base initial.base && RestrictedInitialPolicy.acceptsMark d.mark initial.mark &&
    (dropPrefix d.path initial.path).isSome

def flowStar (initial : Input) : Bool :=
  match initial.mark,initial.shape,initial.must with | .flow,.star,false => true | _,_,_ => false

def asExact (initial : Input) : Input := { initial with shape := .exact,must := false }

def canStoreUsing (image : Mode → AnyDemand → Input → Bool) (mode : Mode)
    (d : AnyDemand) (stored : Input) : Bool :=
  let fits := fun raw => image mode d raw && insideAny d raw
  fits stored || (flowStar stored && fits (asExact stored))

def normalizeFlowKey (initial : Input) : Input :=
  match initial.mark,initial.shape with
  | .flow,.exact => { initial with shape := .star }
  | _,_ => initial

structure StoredRow where
  initial : Input
  opaqueExit : Nat
  layer : Layer
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def c5EntryTicket (image : Mode → AnyDemand → Input → Bool) (mode : Mode)
    (d : AnyDemand) (row : StoredRow) : Option StoredRow :=
  if canStoreUsing image mode d row.initial then some row else none

theorem accepted_entry_ticket_preserves_exit_and_layer
    (image : Mode → AnyDemand → Input → Bool) (mode : Mode) (d : AnyDemand)
    (row selected : StoredRow) (accepted : c5EntryTicket image mode d row = some selected) :
    selected = row := by
  cases gate : canStoreUsing image mode d row.initial with
  | false => simp only [c5EntryTicket,gate,Bool.false_eq_true,if_false] at accepted; cases accepted
  | true => simpa only [c5EntryTicket,gate,if_true,Option.some.injEq] using accepted.symm

def layerOr : Layer → Layer → Layer
  | .normal,.normal => .normal
  | _,_ => .demand

def intrinsic (initial : Input) : Layer :=
  match initial.shape,initial.mark with
  | .any,_ => if initial.must then .normal else .demand
  | .star,.full _ => .demand
  | _,_ => .normal

/-- The current concrete support/loss-bit rule. Recalculation is NOT a blanket
intrinsic-only reset; existing EXACT-on-MAY demotion remains present. -/
def admissionLayer (emitted actual : Input) (supplied : Layer) : Layer :=
  match emitted.mark with
  | .flow => intrinsic emitted
  | .full _ => layerOr (intrinsic emitted)
      (if decide (supplied = .demand) || (RestrictedInitialPolicy.shapeEq emitted.shape .exact && isMay actual)
       then .demand else .normal)

def startLayer (initial : Input) (admitted : Layer) : Layer :=
  layerOr (intrinsic initial) admitted

inductive LayerChoice where | preserveAdmission | recalculateConverted
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def candidateStart (choice : LayerChoice) (old actual : Input) (supplied : Layer) : Layer :=
  let next := replaceMay old
  if isMay old then
    match choice with
    | .preserveAdmission => startLayer next (admissionLayer old actual supplied)
    | .recalculateConverted => startLayer next (admissionLayer next actual supplied)
  else startLayer old (admissionLayer old actual supplied)

/-- Necessary existing target guards after matching. This does not establish
that a relation matched, a concrete source arrived or a target was published. -/
def normalTargetGuard (direction : Direction) (flowOrigin : Bool)
    (matched offered : Layer) : Bool :=
  decide (direction = .forward) && !flowOrigin && decide (layerOr matched offered = .normal)

/-- Tail/layer part of the existing MAY-prefix certificate guard. A failed
certificate does not mean the native fallback or its result is absent. -/
def mayCertificate (expected : List Acc) (initial : Input) (layer : Layer) : Bool :=
  decide (initial.path = expected) && isMay initial && decide (layer = .demand)

/-- ZERO is a typed token outside the ordinary ANY-demand data grammar. -/
inductive TypedInput where | zero | ordinary (fact : Input)
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def replaceTyped : TypedInput → TypedInput
  | .zero => .zero
  | .ordinary initial => .ordinary (replaceMay initial)
def emitTyped (mode : Mode) (d : AnyDemand) : TypedInput → Option TypedInput
  | .zero => none
  | .ordinary actual => (candidateEmit mode d actual).map TypedInput.ordinary

/-- Suffix relation of the copied start fact. It is a local relation abstraction
for ordinary return/copy, not a native driver or all-summary correctness proof. -/
def copiedStart (initial : Input) (resultBase : Nat) : Input := { initial with base := resultBase }
def premiseAllowsSuffix (_initial : Input) (_suffix : List Acc) : Bool := true
def copyRelationAllows (initial : Input) (inputSuffix outputSuffix : List Acc) : Bool :=
  if isMay initial then true else decide (inputSuffix = outputSuffix)

def starSuffixTransfer (entry : Input) (resultBase : Nat) (actual : Input) : Option Input :=
  if Nat.beq entry.base actual.base then
    (dropPrefix entry.path actual.path).map (fun suffix => {actual with base := resultBase,path := suffix})
  else none

theorem STAR_copy_transports_exact_T_suffix (base resultBase : Nat) (path suffix : List Acc) (t : Nat) :
    starSuffixTransfer ⟨base,path,.star,.flow,false⟩ resultBase
      ⟨base,path ++ suffix,.exact,.full t,false⟩ =
      some ⟨resultBase,suffix,.exact,.full t,false⟩ := by
  have removedPrefix : dropPrefix path (path ++ suffix) = some suffix := CoreAux.dropPrefix_some.mpr rfl
  simp only [starSuffixTransfer,Nat.beq_refl,if_true,removedPrefix,Option.map_some]

def forward2 : Mode := ⟨.forward,2⟩
def backward2 : Mode := ⟨.backward,2⟩
def forward1 : Mode := ⟨.forward,1⟩
def p : Nat := 1
def ret : Nat := 2
def f : Acc := 7
def g : Acc := 8
def T : Mark := .full 11
def d0 (mark : Mark) : AnyDemand := ⟨p,[],mark⟩
def d1 (mark : Mark) : AnyDemand := ⟨p,[f],mark⟩
def atF (mark : Mark) : Input := ⟨p,[f],.any,mark,false⟩
def starF (mark : Mark) : Input := ⟨p,[f],.star,mark,false⟩

theorem the_two_current_ANY_result_cells_and_replacements :
    currentEmit forward2 (d1 .flow) (atF T) = some (atF .flow) ∧
    currentEmit forward2 (d1 .flow) ⟨p,[],.any,T,false⟩ = some (atF .flow) ∧
    candidateEmit forward2 (d1 .flow) (atF T) = some (starF .flow) ∧
    candidateEmit forward2 (d1 .flow) ⟨p,[],.any,T,false⟩ = some (starF .flow) ∧
    candidateEmit backward2 (d1 T) (atF T) = some (starF T) := by decide

theorem same_head_STAR_needs_a_new_image_classifier :
    currentCanEmit forward1 (d1 .flow) (starF .flow) = false ∧
    candidateCanEmit forward1 (d1 .flow) (starF .flow) = true ∧
    currentCanEmit forward1 (d1 T) (starF T) = false ∧
    candidateCanEmit forward1 (d1 T) (starF T) = true ∧
    candidateCanEmit forward1 (d1 T) (atF T) = false := by decide

theorem supplied_STAR_still_rejects_and_self_projection_is_incomplete :
    candidateEmit forward1 (d1 .flow) (starF .flow) = none ∧
    candidateEmit forward1 (d1 T) (starF T) = none ∧
    candidateCanEmit forward1 (d1 .flow) (starF .flow) = true := by decide

theorem old_C5_FLOW_normalized_EXACT_fallback_is_not_concrete_STAR_admission :
    normalizeFlowKey ⟨p,[f],.exact,.flow,false⟩ = starF .flow ∧
    canStoreUsing currentCanEmit forward1 (d1 .flow) (starF .flow) = true ∧
    canStoreUsing currentCanEmit forward1 (d1 T) (starF T) = false ∧
    canStoreUsing candidateCanEmit forward1 (d1 T) (starF T) = true := by decide

theorem finer_field_and_terminal_exact_cells_are_unchanged :
    currentEmit forward2 (d0 T) ⟨p,[f],.exact,T,false⟩ =
      candidateEmit forward2 (d0 T) ⟨p,[f],.exact,T,false⟩ ∧
    candidateEmit forward2 (d0 T) ⟨p,[f],.exact,T,false⟩ = some ⟨p,[f],.exact,T,false⟩ ∧
    candidateEmit forward2 (d0 T) ⟨p,[f,g],.exact,T,false⟩ = some (starF T) ∧
    candidateEmit forward1 (d0 T) ⟨p,[f,g],.exact,T,false⟩ = none := by decide

theorem same_head_conversion_needs_no_new_field_budget :
    candidateEmit forward1 (d1 .flow) (atF T) = some (starF .flow) ∧
    candidateEmit forward1 (d1 T) (atF T) = some (starF T) ∧
    candidateEmit forward1 (d1 T) ⟨p,[f,g],.exact,T,false⟩ = none := by decide

theorem MUST_is_not_replaced_and_backward_still_forbids_it :
    candidateEmit forward1 (d1 T) ⟨p,[f],.any,T,true⟩ = some ⟨p,[f],.any,T,true⟩ ∧
    candidateEmit backward2 (d1 T) ⟨p,[f],.any,T,true⟩ = none ∧
    replaceMay ⟨p,[f],.any,.flow,true⟩ = ⟨p,[f],.any,.flow,true⟩ := by decide

theorem FLOW_recalculation_promotes_but_explicit_DEMAND_preservation_does_not :
    intrinsic (atF .flow) = .demand ∧ intrinsic (starF .flow) = .normal ∧
    candidateStart .preserveAdmission (atF .flow) (atF T) .demand = .demand ∧
    candidateStart .recalculateConverted (atF .flow) (atF T) .demand = .normal ∧
    candidateStart .preserveAdmission (atF T) (atF T) .demand = .demand ∧
    candidateStart .recalculateConverted (atF T) (atF T) .demand = .demand := by decide

theorem unrelated_EXACT_on_MAY_loss_bit_is_not_erased :
    admissionLayer ⟨p,[f],.exact,T,false⟩ (atF T) .normal = .demand ∧
    candidateStart .recalculateConverted ⟨p,[f],.exact,T,false⟩ (atF T) .normal = .demand := by decide

theorem FLOW_or_DEMAND_target_guards_prevent_an_immediate_spurious_NORMAL_claim :
    normalTargetGuard .forward true .normal .normal = false ∧
    normalTargetGuard .forward false .demand .normal = false ∧
    normalTargetGuard .forward false .normal .demand = false ∧
    normalTargetGuard .backward false .normal .normal = false ∧
    normalTargetGuard .forward false .normal .normal = true := by decide

theorem both_layer_choices_fail_the_existing_MAY_certificate_tail_guard :
    mayCertificate [f] (atF .flow) .demand = true ∧
    mayCertificate [f] (starF .flow) .demand = false ∧
    mayCertificate [f] (starF .flow) .normal = false := by decide

theorem ZERO_is_excluded_from_the_ordinary_ANY_candidate :
    replaceTyped .zero = .zero ∧ emitTyped forward2 (d0 .flow) .zero = none := by decide

theorem equal_premise_domains_do_not_imply_equal_copied_summary_relations :
    premiseAllowsSuffix (atF .flow) [f] = premiseAllowsSuffix (starF .flow) [f] ∧
    copiedStart (atF .flow) ret = ⟨ret,[f],.any,.flow,false⟩ ∧
    copiedStart (starF .flow) ret = ⟨ret,[f],.star,.flow,false⟩ ∧
    copyRelationAllows (atF .flow) [f] [g] = true ∧
    copyRelationAllows (starF .flow) [f] [g] = false ∧
    copyRelationAllows (starF .flow) [f] [f] = true := by decide

/-- Conditional header-cost abstraction only. It assumes an already protected
MAY or STAR root after the primer and models the supplied strong-write E step.
No AP/runtime/owner enabling, scheduling or cost measurement is inferred. -/
inductive ProtectedHead where | may | star
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def strongWriteHeader (head : ProtectedHead) (e : List Acc) (field : Acc) : List Acc :=
  match head with | .may => [] | .star => e ++ [field]
def optionalHeader (head : ProtectedHead) (current : List (List Acc)) (field : Acc) : List (List Acc) :=
  (current ++ current.map (fun e => strongWriteHeader head e field)).eraseDups

def headerStages (head : ProtectedHead) : List (List (List Acc)) :=
  let h0 : List (List Acc) := [[]]
  let h1 := optionalHeader head h0 1
  let h2 := optionalHeader head h1 2
  let h3 := optionalHeader head h2 3
  let h4 := optionalHeader head h3 4
  let h5 := optionalHeader head h4 5
  [h0,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5]

theorem conditional_literal_H_header_family_is_one_versus_thirty_two :
    (headerStages .may).map List.length = [1,1,1,1,1,1] ∧
    (headerStages .star).map List.length = [1,2,4,8,16,32] ∧
    ((headerStages .star).getLast!).eraseDups.length = 32 := by decide

theorem concrete_STAR_header_family_does_not_require_a_NORMAL_promotion :
    intrinsic (starF T) = .demand ∧
    candidateStart .preserveAdmission (atF T) (atF T) .demand = .demand ∧
    candidateStart .recalculateConverted (atF T) (atF T) .demand = .demand := by decide

def check : Bool :=
  candidateCanEmit forward1 (d1 .flow) (starF .flow) &&
  !currentCanEmit forward1 (d1 .flow) (starF .flow) &&
  canStoreUsing currentCanEmit forward1 (d1 .flow) (starF .flow) &&
  !canStoreUsing currentCanEmit forward1 (d1 T) (starF T) &&
  decide (candidateStart .recalculateConverted (atF .flow) (atF T) .demand = .normal) &&
  !mayCertificate [f] (starF .flow) .demand

theorem executable_investigation_cells : check = true := by decide

# Nested-call STAR initial investigation

Status: **prepared only; no job or compiler executed**. The root owns all
execution. This is an unselected policy experiment, not production code.

The conditional model in the checked `MayInitialToStarAuditRootChecked.lean`
shows a local case: an outer MAY initial currently supplies MAY to a child;
conversion can instead supply STAR, which the unchanged same-path MAY-demand
C2 cell rejects. That case is not yet a full-program coverage counterexample.
Saved summaries or another ordinary route may preserve the finding.

These four finite programs test that question through the native driver:

| Case | Wrapper on getF | Wrappers on getG | Methods |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| direct | 0 | 0 | 3 |
| wrapG1 | 0 | 1 | 4 |
| wrapG2 | 0 | 2 | 5 |
| wrapFG | 1 | 1 | 5 |

```java
// Objects and the Element slot are initialized finite-IR preconditions.
T s = sourceExactT();
temp.g = s;
next.f = temp;
x = outerF(next);     // getF itself, or an ordinary wrapper around it.
y = outerG(x);        // getG itself, or one/two ordinary wrappers.
out.Element.h = y;
sinkExactT(out.Element.h);

Object getF(Object p) { return p.f; }
Object getG(Object p) { return p.g; }
Object wrapChild(Object p) { Object v = child(p); return v; }
```

The direct case retains the known positive three-method control's CFG, exact
source action, sink pattern and field effects. The JUnit class and fixture
names differ. The other cases only add these ordinary wrapper bodies and
redirect the relevant root call. `programs.json` names the source control.
No summary, demand, initial, contributor or source permission is injected.
In particular, wrapper methods use native calls and return instructions;
they are not predefined summaries. The native algorithm derives all guidance.

Each case expects one NORMAL finding and natural `COMPLETE/NO_DEMAND_EDGE`.
Assertions are the same for current and candidate variants. Do not weaken
them after observing a result. A candidate failure is a coverage regression
only if the same exact case passes under the current policy and the trace
supports the claimed mechanism. A timeout or origin/check failure is censored,
not a missing finding proved by this test.

## Three isolated classpaths

The current variant has the unique test class only. It loads production C2
from the native main output. FLOW-only and all-MAY add only the exact copied
`RestrictedInitialPolicy` family used in the prior original-loop experiment.
Those source copies are byte-checked against the frozen earlier candidates.
No other native class is overlaid. The two cells and raw-image updates remain
unchanged from that experiment; layer, matching roles, MUST and actual-STAR
rejection stay native. Public APIs are unchanged by these copies.

Root must first review the existing checked 26-law local model and confirm all
prior jobs terminal. `-PnestedStarRootConfirmed=true` records that root review;
the preparation does not supply it. `freeze...Runtime` compiles/packages the
chosen dependencies before freezing their actual bytes. `test...` then checks
the freeze before starting and preserves a one-shot start receipt. Both tasks
reject changed source pins. The finalizer checks runtime/source bytes again.

No baseline Git revision or real project is rerun. Each child is a native
JUnit worker with 1 GiB, one CPU, one fork. Each individual analysis keeps the
20-second budget and FULL limits `1,1,2,3,...,9`. A suite has four cases and a
100-second task cap, including diagnostics. Root must poll its live handle and
keep user updates; do not run the three suites concurrently. Gradle has 2 GiB,
two CPUs, one worker and the in-process Kotlin compiler.

## Root-only command sequence

Use `ROOT-COMMANDS.txt` from repository `core`. Execute exactly one line at a
time, wait for terminal exit and inspect the receipt before proceeding:

1. Freeze current; run current's four cases.
2. Freeze all-MAY (the FULL strategy); run the same four cases.
3. Optional: freeze FLOW-only; run the same four cases.

Each freeze and run has a separate new log. No aggregate task, automatic retry,
process watcher or signal helper is present. Preserve a failed command. It is
not permission to rerun over its evidence directory.

The Test task executes only `NestedStarInitialCandidateTest`. Native
`testClasses` can compile dependencies but does not execute the default suite.
The overlay check permits only that test family, the selected policy family
and Kotlin module metadata. Class-origin checks verify main engine/transfer/
layer/C5/store classes still come from native main and DriverFixtures from
native test output.

## Outputs and interpretation

Per variant: `runtime-freeze.json`, `root-execution-started.json`, complete
`test-output.log`, JUnit XML, `suite-result.json`, `processed.jsonl` and
`root-evidence.json`. The original run/end/result lines are native observations.
The finalizer does not synthesize missing frontiers. Each result includes the
latest reached run, terminal run/status/reason, first reporting run and actual
NORMAL count. Root must distinguish engine completion and accepted report.

Processed observations are the fixture's immutable post-statement EdgeDelta
values, read only after analysis. They include run, method, instruction,
complete original members, field IDs, tail, mark, exclusions, support layer
and whether H occurs. The native `f/g/h/Element/T` catalog is printed per case.
These programs have no protection-producing cleaner or mark cycle.
The trace is complete only when the recorded row count is at most 2,000;
otherwise `processedTraceComplete=false` and no rows are printed. A complete
post-statement trace still is not a direct rejected-C2 callback capture.

No current/PASS, candidate/FAIL, new causal mechanism, global soundness,
termination or project performance result is claimed by preparation.

# Concrete STAR through an ordinary wrapper

Status: prepared only. No compilation, analyzer, JVM, test or Lean job was run.
This directory adds two native programs. It does not change the frozen four
getter cases or their results. Root executes all jobs sequentially.

```java
// All required objects/fields exist. Rules, not helper implementations:
// sourceExactT() assigns exact T to its output.
// convert's single source rule: CM(p.[any],T) assigns U at ret.f.g.$.
// No FLOW edge transfers p to convert's ret.
Object convert(Object p) {
    Object ret = initializedResult();
    guardedSourceRule(p, ret); // Native ordinary source micro-edge below.
    return ret;
}
Object wrap(Object p) { Object v = convert(p); return v; }
void main() {
    Object t = sourceExactT();
    Object y = convert(t); // direct case; wrapped case calls wrap(t).
    sinkExactU(y.f.g);
}
```

The guarded operation is the legal native single-premise source transfer
`arg(0).[any]/T -> ret.f.g.$/U`, with an actual `RuleOccurrenceId` and
`ActionId(..., SOURCE, ...)`. `MicroEdgeBuilder.sourceEdge` and `buildStage`
include both endpoint bases in touched metadata. `keepZero` supplies only
ordinary control. No predefined summary, C2 input, demand, source permission
or source-hit record is injected. The wrapper has an ordinary resolved call
and return move.

The question is whether the new concrete STAR initial creates the same nested
admission obstruction as the earlier FLOW case. Source-derived candidate:

```text
R1 marked guard input: p.$/T,N
R1 U output: ret.f.g.$/U,N -> field-limit1 -> ret.f.[any]/U,D
B2 old initial under ret.f.[any]/U demand: ret.f.[any]/U,D
B2 all-MAY candidate initial: ret.f.*/U,D
wrapper reversed return/bind: candidate reaches child as ret.f.*/U,D
unchanged same-head ANY-demand/STAR-actual cell: emits nothing
```

These are the proposed trace cells, not executed outcomes. The checked local
26-law model already covers the same-head STAR rejection and concrete STAR's
DEMAND layer. It does not prove this full program reaches the cells or loses
its finding. Direct and wrapped current/candidate results are all unknown.

Each case requires exactly one NORMAL finding and natural
`COMPLETE/NO_DEMAND_EDGE`. The same assertions apply to both variants. Preserve
a failing test. A current-PASS/candidate-FAIL contrast is required before a
new coverage-loss claim. A compiler/origin failure or timeout is not that
contrast. No FLOW p-to-ret relation exists in the converter to bypass the
guarded mark dependency by an ordinary copied-return record.

Root-only `ROOT-COMMANDS.txt` uses current freeze/test, then all-MAY freeze/test,
one command at a time. Existing parent jobs must be terminal. Review pins and
the checked conditional model first. Set `-PconcreteStarRootConfirmed=true`
only after that review. Both policies have the same full program. The sole
candidate policy family is byte-identical to the tested all-MAY source copy.
No production class besides that family can come from external output.

The common test checks class origins. All main engine/transfer/layer/C5/store
classes remain native; fixture code remains native test output. Each analysis
uses FULL, limits `1,1,2,3,...,9`, 20 seconds. A native JUnit worker has 1 GiB,
one CPU and one fork; the two-case Test task cap is 60 seconds. Gradle uses
2 GiB/two CPUs/one worker/in-process Kotlin. Native `testClasses` may compile
dependencies but does not execute the default suite.

Freeze packages runtime producers before hashing. Each test checks its freeze,
creates a one-shot start receipt and preserves complete stdout and JUnit XML.
The finalizer checks frozen source/runtime bytes and emits actual case results
with latest reached run, terminal run/status/reason, first reporting run and
report count. No per-run frontier is synthesized.

Bounded processed observations capture the fixture's dequeued EdgeDelta before
transfer at its instruction. The complete source original, mark, path, E,
layer and H-presence are printed for every row when there are at most 2,000.
Otherwise `processedTraceComplete=false`. This is not a direct rejected-C2
callback capture. Source fields f/g and marks T/U are printed per case.

Preparation is no claim of a result, implementation selection or global proof.

from pathlib import Path

import json

def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def pin(path):
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    return dict(path=str(path), bytes=len(raw), sha256=sha(raw))


def read_variant(name):
    path = BASE / 'output' / name / 'processed.jsonl'
    rows = []
    for line, text in enumerate(path.read_text().splitlines(), 1):
        row = json.loads(text)
        if row['case'] == 'wrapG1':
            rows.append(dict(line=line, row=row))
    evidence_path = path.parent / 'root-evidence.json'
    evidence = json.loads(evidence_path.read_text())
    case = next(c for c in evidence['actualCaseResults'] if c['case'] == 'wrapG1')
    assert case['processedTraceComplete'] is True and case['processedRows'] == len(rows)
    return rows, case, [pin(path), pin(evidence_path)]


def choose(rows, run, owner, node, base, tail, mark='Star(excluded={})', premise_base=None, premise_tail=None):
    found = []
    for item in rows:
        row = item['row']
        if row['run'] != run or row['method'] != f'Nested wrapG1 {owner} [context]' or row['node'] != f'Nested wrapG1 {owner}:{node}':
            continue
        if len(row['leaves']) != 1:
            continue
        leaf = row['leaves'][0]
        if (leaf['base'], leaf['tail'], leaf['mark']) != (base, tail, mark):
            continue
        if premise_base is not None and not all(member['base'] == premise_base for member in row['premise']):
            continue
        if premise_tail is not None and not all(member['tail'] == premise_tail for member in row['premise']):
            continue
        found.append(item)
    assert len(found) == 1, (run, owner, node, base, tail, len(found))
    return found[0]

allmay, allmay_case, allmay_pins = read_variant('all-may')

    initial_tail = 'ANY' if name == 'current' else 'STAR'

/** Check bounded actual run-2 inputs. A correlated field STAR keeps its E.
 * Returns true for a named FULL field and false for an exact class marker.
 * Acceptance does not authorize an initial or add a source/sink literal shape. */
internal fun validateRun2StaticFullInput(ap: ApManager, actual: Pattern, fieldLimit: Int = 1): Boolean {
    require(fieldLimit >= 1) { "The field limit must be positive" }
    val field = validateRun2StaticFullAnchor(ap, actual) ?: return false
    val fact = actual.fact
    val location = if (field) fact.path.drop(1).all { it.isCounted() } &&
        fact.path.count { it.isCounted() } <= fieldLimit &&
        (fact.tail == Tail.EXACT || fact.tail == Tail.ANY || fact.tail == Tail.STAR)
    else fact.path.size == 1 && fact.tail == Tail.EXACT
    val exclusion = actual.exclusion == ExclusionSet.Empty || field && fact.tail == Tail.STAR
    check(location && exclusion) {
        "Unsupported run-2 concrete static input: $actual. " +
            "Expected a named field within limit $fieldLimit with EXACT/ANY and empty field exclusions, " +
            "a named field with correlated STAR and its legal field exclusion, " +
            "or an EXACT class marker with empty field exclusions. Backward MUST is forbidden."
    }
    return field
}

/** Check only the static anchor of a current result. Its existing header stays
 * intact; the bounded backward-input validator separately rejects MUST.
 * Deeper field suffixes are lawful before the normal field cut.
 * Returns true for a named field, false for an exact class marker, null otherwise. */
internal fun validateRun2StaticFullAnchor(ap: ApManager, actual: Pattern): Boolean? {
    if (actual.fact.base != STATIC) return null
    val atom = (actual.fact.mark as? MarkSlot.Concrete)?.mark ?: return null
    if (ap.marks.fullId(atom) == null) return null // GROUP guidance is metadata, not an actual FULL mark.
    val path = actual.fact.path
    val field = path.size >= 2 && path[0].isClass() &&
        ap.accessors.accessor(path[1]) is FieldAccessor
    val exactClass = path.size == 1 && path[0].isClass() && actual.fact.tail == Tail.EXACT
    check(field || exactClass) {
        "Unsupported run-2 concrete static input: $actual. " +
            "Expected a named JVM static field anchor or an EXACT class marker; " +
            "broad root/class marks require a separate query adapter (run1-static-summary-erasure.md section 3)."
    }
    return field
}

/** Select a fixture mode only while the production driver captures its immutable setting. */
internal fun <T> withRun1MarkMode(mode: MarkMode, body: () -> T): T {
    val property = "opentaint.bidi.run1MarkMode"
    val previous = System.getProperty(property)
    try {
        System.setProperty(property, mode.name)
        return body()
    } finally {
        if (previous == null) System.clearProperty(property) else System.setProperty(property, previous)
    }
}

data class ProgramCase(val root: MethodKey, val rule: RuleId, val sink: CommonInst, val source: PathEdge)
data class DriverInput(val run: Int, val callee: MethodKey, val link: Link)
data class DriverProcessed(val run: Int, val method: MethodKey, val delta: EdgeDelta)
data class DemandLinkCase(val root: MethodKey, val sourceMethod: MethodKey, val reader: MethodKey,
                          val sinkMethod: MethodKey, val rule: RuleId, val sink: CommonInst,
                          val source: PathEdge, val q: Int, val r: Int, val g: Int, val h: Int,
                          val mark: TaintMark)

/** Joined engine results are retained here only as explicit test observations. */
class DriverFixtures(threads: Int = 1) : AutoCloseable {
    val program = FiniteProgramFixtures(threads = threads)
    val shared get() = program.shared
    val manager get() = program.manager
    val ops get() = program.ops
    val records get() = program.records
    val vulnerabilities get() = program.vulnerabilities
    val cancellation get() = program.cancellation
    val refManager get() = program.refManager
    val configs = ArrayList<RunConfig>()
    val results = ArrayList<RunResult<RunMethodAnalyzer>>()
    val timeouts = ArrayList<Duration>()
    private val processRows = ConcurrentLinkedQueue<DriverProcessed>()
    private val inputRows = ConcurrentLinkedQueue<DriverInput>()
    fun links(run: Int, method: MethodKey): List<Link> = inputRows.filter { it.run == run && it.callee == method }.map { it.link }.distinct()
    val processed: List<DriverProcessed> get() = processRows.toList()

    fun manager(config: RunConfig, owner: SharedObjects = shared): RunManager<RunMethodAnalyzer> {
        val actual = RunMethodHandlers(MethodLocalServicesFactory(::RunMethodLocalServices),
            MethodCallServicesFactory(::RunMethodCallServices))
        val factory = RunnerHandlerFactory<RunMethodAnalyzer> { port ->
            val observed = object : RunnerPort<RunMethodAnalyzer> by port {
                // Restricted input stays in the caller. Observe eligible bindings
                // at subscription, not at the now-key-only callee packet.
                override fun subscribe(sub: Subscription) {
                    if (config.restricted && !sub.zeroOnly) ops.leaves(sub.added).forEach {
                        inputRows += DriverInput(config.index, sub.callee, Link(it, sub.linkLayer, sub.ref))
                    }
                    port.subscribe(sub)
                }
                override fun link(callee: MethodKey, ref: CallerRef, linkLayer: Layer, added: Facts) {
                    ops.leaves(added).forEach { inputRows += DriverInput(config.index, callee, Link(it, linkLayer, ref)) }
                    port.link(callee, ref, linkLayer, added)
                }
                override val onProcess: (MethodKey, EdgeDelta) -> Unit = { key, delta ->
                    processRows += DriverProcessed(config.index, key, delta)
                    port.onProcess?.invoke(key, delta)
                }
            }
            actual.create(observed)
        }
        return RunManager(config, owner, factory, quantum = 1)
    }

    fun run(config: RunConfig, owner: SharedObjects = shared,
            timeout: Duration = 5.seconds): RunResult<RunMethodAnalyzer> {
        configs += config
        timeouts += timeout
        return manager(config, owner).run(timeout).also(results::add)
    }

    fun driver(policy: IterationPolicy, budget: Duration = 5.seconds,
               invokeRun: (RunConfig, SharedObjects, Duration) -> RunResult<RunMethodAnalyzer> = this::run,
               run1MarkMode: MarkMode? = null,
               guardBarrier: (SharedObjects, () -> Next) -> Next = { _, body -> body() }): IterationDriver =
        if (run1MarkMode == null) IterationDriver(policy, shared, budget, invokeRun, guardBarrier)
        else withRun1MarkMode(run1MarkMode) { IterationDriver(policy, shared, budget, invokeRun, guardBarrier) }

    fun rule(id: String): RuleId = object : CommonTaintConfigurationSink {
        override val id = id
        override val meta = object : CommonTaintConfigurationSinkMeta {
            override val message = id
            override val severity = CommonTaintConfigurationSinkMeta.Severity.Warning
        }
    }

    fun summary(vararg edges: PathEdge): StatementSummary =
        StatementSummary(edges.map { it.from.base }.toSet(), edges.map(MicroEdge::of), emptyList(), emptyMap())

    private fun sourceRules(edge: PathEdge): RuleStatement =
        RuleStatement(summary(ZERO_KEEP, edge), StatementSummary.EMPTY, emptyList())

    private fun exitSink(sink: SinkRule): ExitRules =
        ExitRules(RuleStatement(StatementSummary.EMPTY, StatementSummary.EMPTY, listOf(sink)), false, emptySet())

    /** A normal root witness remains an unproved candidate under the minimal report policy. */
    fun confirmed(): ProgramCase {
        val root = program.method("confirmed", listOf(listOf(1), emptyList()), 1).key()
        val mark = MarkSlot.Concrete(program.mark("confirmed T"))
        val base = AccessPathBase.LocalVar(0)
        val source = PathEdge(ZERO_FACT, PathFact(base, emptyList(), Tail.EXACT, mark), ExclusionSet.Empty)
        val sink = SinkRule(rule("confirmed sink"), 0, listOf(program.pattern(base, mark = mark)), emptyList())
        program.entry(root, sourceRules(source))
        program.exit(root, 1, exitSink(sink))
        return ProgramCase(root, sink.rule, program.inst(root, 1), source)
    }

    /** The explicit may pass keeps this finding unconfirmed at every field limit. */
    fun persistentDemand(): ProgramCase {
        val root = program.method("persistent demand", listOf(listOf(1), listOf(2), emptyList()), 2).key()
        val mark = MarkSlot.Concrete(program.mark("persistent T"))
        val base = AccessPathBase.LocalVar(0)
        val source = PathEdge(ZERO_FACT, PathFact(base, emptyList(), Tail.EXACT, mark), ExclusionSet.Empty)
        val may = PathEdge(source.to, PathFact(AccessPathBase.Return, emptyList(), Tail.ANY, mark), ExclusionSet.Empty)
        val sink = SinkRule(rule("persistent sink"), 0,
            listOf(program.pattern(AccessPathBase.Return, tail = Tail.ANY, mark = mark)), emptyList())
        program.entry(root, sourceRules(source))
        program.statement(root, 1, summary(may))
        program.exit(root, 2, exitSink(sink))
        return ProgramCase(root, sink.rule, program.inst(root, 2), source)
    }

    /** A longer exact source is cut in run 1 and recovered by a real backward source hit. */
    fun refining(): ProgramCase {
        val root = program.method("refining", listOf(listOf(1), emptyList()), 1).key()
        val mark = MarkSlot.Concrete(program.mark("refining T"))
        val path = listOf(program.field("a"), program.field("b"))
        val source = PathEdge(ZERO_FACT, PathFact(AccessPathBase.Return, path, Tail.EXACT, mark), ExclusionSet.Empty)
        val sink = SinkRule(rule("refining sink"), 0, listOf(Pattern(source.to, ExclusionSet.Empty)), emptyList())
        program.entry(root, sourceRules(source))
        program.exit(root, 1, exitSink(sink))
        return ProgramCase(root, sink.rule, program.inst(root, 1), source)
    }

    /** Two different normal call sites cannot jointly support one callee conjunction. */
    fun unsupportedJoint(): ProgramCase {
        val root = program.method("separate sites", listOf(listOf(1), listOf(2), listOf(3), emptyList()), 3).key()
        val callee = program.method("joint sink", listOf(listOf(1), emptyList()), 1).key()
        val first = AccessPathBase.LocalVar(0)
        val second = AccessPathBase.LocalVar(1)
        val arg0 = AccessPathBase.Argument(0)
        val arg1 = AccessPathBase.Argument(1)
        val t = MarkSlot.Concrete(program.mark("joint T"))
        val u = MarkSlot.Concrete(program.mark("joint U"))
        val source = PathEdge(ZERO_FACT, PathFact(first, emptyList(), Tail.EXACT, t), ExclusionSet.Empty)
        val other = PathEdge(ZERO_FACT, PathFact(second, emptyList(), Tail.EXACT, u), ExclusionSet.Empty)
        val sink = SinkRule(rule("unsupported joint sink"), 0,
            listOf(program.pattern(arg0, mark = t), program.pattern(arg1, mark = u)), emptyList())
        program.entry(root, RuleStatement(summary(ZERO_KEEP, source, other), StatementSummary.EMPTY, emptyList()))
        fun call(value: AccessPathBase, argument: AccessPathBase) = CallPlan(setOf(value), listOf(
            CallStage.Edges(BEFORE, BOUND, BIND_IN, summary(starEdge(value, emptyList(), argument, emptyList()), ZERO_KEEP)),
            CallStage.Actions(BOUND, ADDED, emptyList()),
            CallStage.Callees(ADDED, RETURNED, listOf(callee)),
            CallStage.Actions(RETURNED, REWRITTEN, emptyList()),
            CallStage.Edges(REWRITTEN, AFTER, BIND_BACK, summary(ZERO_KEEP)),
        ), emptyList(), BEFORE, AFTER)
        program.call(root, 1, call(first, arg0))
        program.call(root, 2, call(second, arg1))
        program.exit(callee, 1, exitSink(sink))
        return ProgramCase(root, sink.rule, program.inst(callee, 1), source)
    }

    /** DLINK: srcAny; c(x) reads q then r; m cleans its root EXACT before the g.h sink and throws. */
    fun demandLink(): DemandLinkCase {
        val root = program.method("dlink root", listOf(listOf(1), listOf(2), listOf(3), emptyList()), 3).key()
        val sourceMethod = program.method("dlink srcAny", listOf(listOf(1), emptyList()), 1).key()
        val reader = program.method("dlink c", listOf(listOf(1), listOf(2), listOf(3), listOf(4), emptyList()), 4).key()
        // The normal exit is unreachable. Reached requirements and the sink flow through the exceptional exit.
        val sinkMethod = program.method("dlink m", listOf(listOf(1), listOf(2), emptyList(), emptyList()),
            normalExit = 3, exceptionalExit = 2).key()
        val dto = AccessPathBase.LocalVar(0)
        val temporary = AccessPathBase.LocalVar(1)
        val value = AccessPathBase.LocalVar(2)
        val argument = AccessPathBase.Argument(0)
        val returned = AccessPathBase.Return
        val q = program.field("q")
        val r = program.field("r")
        val g = program.field("g")
        val h = program.field("h")
        val taint = program.mark("DLINK T")
        val mark = MarkSlot.Concrete(taint)
        val source = PathEdge(ZERO_FACT, PathFact(returned, emptyList(), Tail.ANY_TAINT, mark), ExclusionSet.Empty)
        program.entry(sourceMethod, sourceRules(source))
        fun resolved(callee: MethodKey, bindIn: StatementSummary, bindBack: StatementSummary,
                     touched: Set<AccessPathBase>, cleaner: Cleaner? = null): CallPlan = CallPlan(touched, listOf(
            CallStage.Edges(BEFORE, BOUND, BIND_IN, bindIn),
            CallStage.Actions(BOUND, ADDED, cleaner?.let { listOf(CleanStep.Clean(it)) }.orEmpty()),
            CallStage.Callees(ADDED, RETURNED, listOf(callee)),
            CallStage.Actions(RETURNED, REWRITTEN, emptyList()),
            CallStage.Edges(REWRITTEN, AFTER, BIND_BACK, bindBack),
        ), emptyList(), BEFORE, AFTER)
        program.call(root, 1, resolved(sourceMethod, summary(ZERO_KEEP),
            summary(starEdge(returned, emptyList(), dto, emptyList()), ZERO_KEEP), setOf(dto)))
        program.call(root, 2, resolved(reader, summary(starEdge(dto, emptyList(), argument, emptyList()), ZERO_KEEP),
            summary(ZERO_KEEP), setOf(dto)))
        program.statement(reader, 1, StatementSummary(setOf(argument, temporary),
            listOf(MicroEdge.of(keepEdge(argument)), MicroEdge.of(starEdge(argument, listOf(q), temporary, emptyList()))),
            emptyList(), emptyMap()))
        program.statement(reader, 2, StatementSummary(setOf(temporary, value),
            listOf(MicroEdge.of(keepEdge(temporary)), MicroEdge.of(starEdge(temporary, listOf(r), value, emptyList()))),
            emptyList(), emptyMap()))
        program.call(reader, 3, resolved(sinkMethod, summary(starEdge(value, emptyList(), argument, emptyList()), ZERO_KEEP),
            summary(ZERO_KEEP), setOf(value), Cleaner(argument, null, CleanReach.EXACT, taint)))
        val sink = SinkRule(rule("DLINK sink"), 0, listOf(program.pattern(argument, listOf(g, h), mark = mark)), emptyList())
        program.call(sinkMethod, 1, CallPlan(setOf(argument), listOf(
            CallStage.Edges(BEFORE, BOUND, BIND_IN, summary(keepEdge(argument), ZERO_KEEP)),
            CallStage.Actions(BOUND, ADDED, emptyList()),
            CallStage.Edges(ADDED, RETURNED, UNRESOLVED, summary(keepEdge(argument), ZERO_KEEP)),
            CallStage.Actions(RETURNED, REWRITTEN, emptyList()),
            CallStage.Edges(REWRITTEN, AFTER, BIND_BACK, summary(keepEdge(argument), ZERO_KEEP)),
        ), listOf(sink), BEFORE, AFTER))
        return DemandLinkCase(root, sourceMethod, reader, sinkMethod, sink.rule, program.inst(sinkMethod, 1),
            source, q, r, g, h, taint)
    }

    override fun close(): Unit = program.close()
}

/** Real shell services over a small, fixed common IR graph. */
class EngineShellFixtures(val cancellation: Cancellation = Cancellation(),
                          markDeclarations: MarkDeclarations = COMMON_FIXTURE_DECLARATIONS) {
    data class Context(val name: String) : MethodContext
    data class Unit(val name: String) : UnitType

    private class Method(override val name: String) : CommonMethod {
        override val parameters: List<CommonMethodParameter> = emptyList()
        override val returnType = object : CommonTypeName { override val typeName = "java.lang.Object" }
        override fun flowGraph(): ControlFlowGraph<CommonInst> = error("The fixture supplies its compact graph")
        override fun toString(): String = name
    }

    val methodA: CommonMethod = Method("methodA")
    val methodB: CommonMethod = Method("methodB")
    val methodUnknown: CommonMethod = Method("methodUnknown")
    val unitA: UnitType = Unit("A")
    val unitB: UnitType = Unit("B")
    val unitResolver = UnitResolver<CommonMethod> { method -> when (method) {
        methodA -> unitA
        methodB -> unitB
        else -> UnknownUnit
    } }

    val refManager = RefManager()
    val manager = testApManager(cancellation, refManager, markDeclarations)
    val ops = ApOps(manager)
    val records = PersistentRecordStore(manager)
    val vulnerabilities = ConcurrentVulnerabilityStore(manager)
    private val instructions = ConcurrentHashMap<Pair<CommonMethod, Int>, CommonInst>()
    private val graphs = ConcurrentHashMap<Pair<CommonMethod, Direction>, MethodInstGraph>()
    private val forms = ConcurrentHashMap<MethodKey, MethodForms>()
    val callExpr = object : CommonCallExpr {
        override val typeName = "java.lang.Object"
        override val args: List<CommonValue> = emptyList()
    }

    fun inst(method: CommonMethod, index: Int): CommonInst {
        require(index in 0..4)
        return instructions.computeIfAbsent(method to index) { object : CommonInst {
            override val location = object : CommonInstLocation {
                override val method = method
                override val index = index
            }
            override fun toString(): String = "${method.name}:$index"
        } }
    }

    fun key(method: CommonMethod = methodA, context: String = "context", entry: Int = 0): MethodKey =
        MethodKey(Context(context), inst(method, entry))

    val a: MethodKey = key(methodA)
    val b: MethodKey = key(methodB)
    val unknown: MethodKey = key(methodUnknown)

    val language = object : LanguageManager {
        override fun getInstIndex(inst: CommonInst): Int = inst.location.index
        override fun getMaxInstIndex(method: CommonMethod): Int = 4
        override fun getInstByIndex(method: CommonMethod, index: Int): CommonInst = inst(method, index)
        override fun isEmpty(method: CommonMethod): Boolean = false
        override fun getCallExpr(inst: CommonInst): CommonCallExpr? = callExpr.takeIf { inst.location.index == 2 }
        override fun producesExceptionalControlFlow(inst: CommonInst): Boolean = inst.location.index == 2
        override fun getCalleeMethod(callExpr: CommonCallExpr): CommonMethod = methodB
        override val methodContextSerializer: MethodContextSerializer get() = error("Unused by shell tests")
    }

    fun graph(method: CommonMethod, direction: Direction): MethodInstGraph = graphs.computeIfAbsent(method to direction) {
        val successors = if (direction == Direction.FORWARD)
            listOf(listOf(1), listOf(2), listOf(3, 4), emptyList(), emptyList())
        else listOf(emptyList(), listOf(0), listOf(1), listOf(2), listOf(2))
        val compact = CompactGraph.build(5) { index -> BitSet().apply { successors[index].forEach(::set) } }
        val exits = BitSet().apply {
            if (direction == Direction.FORWARD) { set(3); set(4) } else set(0)
        }
        MethodInstGraph(Array(5) { inst(method, it) }, compact, exits)
    }

    fun methodForms(key: MethodKey): MethodForms = forms.computeIfAbsent(key) {
        val statement = StatementSummary(setOf(AccessPathBase.Argument(0)),
            listOf(MicroEdge.of(starEdge(AccessPathBase.Argument(0), emptyList(), AccessPathBase.Return, emptyList()))),
            emptyList(), emptyMap())
        val backwardStatement = statement.reversed()
        val entry = RuleStatement(StatementSummary.identities(listOf(AccessPathBase.Zero, AccessPathBase.Argument(0))),
            StatementSummary.EMPTY, emptyList())
        val backwardEntry = entry.reversed()
        val forwardExit = ExitRules(entry, globalStateDrop = true, entryMarks = setOf(manager.marks.mark("entry")))
        val backwardExit = ExitRules(forwardExit.reversed(), false, emptySet())
        val forwardCall = CallPlan(setOf(AccessPathBase.Argument(0), AccessPathBase.Return),
            listOf(CallStage.Edges(CallPoint.BEFORE, CallPoint.AFTER, StageKind.PASS_OVER, statement)),
            emptyList(), CallPoint.BEFORE, CallPoint.AFTER)
        val backwardCall = forwardCall.reversed()
        object : MethodForms {
            override fun statement(direction: Direction, s: CommonInst): StatementSummary =
                if (direction == Direction.FORWARD) statement else backwardStatement
            override fun call(direction: Direction, s: CommonInst, call: CommonCallExpr): CallPlan =
                if (direction == Direction.FORWARD) forwardCall else backwardCall
            override fun entryRules(direction: Direction): RuleStatement =
                if (direction == Direction.FORWARD) entry else backwardEntry
            override fun exitRules(direction: Direction, exit: CommonInst): ExitRules =
                if (direction == Direction.FORWARD) forwardExit else backwardExit
        }
    }

    val interpreter = object : Interpreter {
        override fun entryNode(method: MethodKey): CommonInst = method.statement
        override fun exitNodes(method: MethodKey): List<ExitNode> =
            listOf(ExitNode(inst(method.method, 3), false), ExitNode(inst(method.method, 4), true))
        override fun entryRules(method: MethodKey): RuleStatement = methodForms(method).entryRules(Direction.FORWARD)
        override fun exitRules(method: MethodKey, exit: CommonInst): ExitRules =
            methodForms(method).exitRules(Direction.FORWARD, exit)
        override fun statementSummary(method: MethodKey, statement: CommonInst): StatementSummary =
            methodForms(method).statement(Direction.FORWARD, statement)
        override fun callPlan(caller: MethodKey, statement: CommonInst, call: CommonCallExpr): CallPlan =
            methodForms(caller).call(Direction.FORWARD, statement, call)
        override fun isSummaryBase(base: AccessPathBase): Boolean =
            base !is AccessPathBase.LocalVar && base !is AccessPathBase.CleanerTemporary
    }
    val contexts = MethodContextCache(interpreter, object : MethodContextSource {
        override fun forms(key: MethodKey): MethodForms = methodForms(key)
        override fun graph(key: MethodKey, direction: Direction): MethodInstGraph = graph(key.method, direction)
    })

    fun shared(threads: Int = 1, unitResolver: UnitResolver<CommonMethod> = this.unitResolver,
               cancellationTimeout: Duration = 1.seconds, diagnostics: Boolean = false): SharedObjects =
        SharedObjects(manager, ops, interpreter, language, contexts, records, unitResolver,
            refManager, cancellation, threads, cancellationTimeout, diagnostics)

    fun config(index: Int = 1, L: Int = maxOf(1, index - 1), roots: List<MethodKey> = listOf(a),
               demand: DemandStore? = if (index == 1) null else DemandStore.Builder(manager).build(),
               seeds: SeedIndex = SeedIndex.EMPTY): RunConfig =
        RunConfig(index, L, demand, records.view(), seeds, roots)

    fun field(name: String): Int = manager.accessors.index(FieldAccessor("Box", name, "Box"))
    fun pattern(base: AccessPathBase = AccessPathBase.Argument(0), path: List<Int> = emptyList(),
                tail: Tail = Tail.EXACT, mark: MarkSlot = MarkSlot.Concrete(manager.marks.mark("T")),
                exclusion: ExclusionSet = ExclusionSet.Empty): Pattern = Pattern(PathFact(base, path, tail, mark), exclusion)
    fun fact(base: AccessPathBase = AccessPathBase.Argument(0), path: List<Int> = emptyList(),
             tail: Tail = Tail.EXACT, mark: MarkSlot = MarkSlot.Concrete(manager.marks.mark("T")),
             exclusion: ExclusionSet = ExclusionSet.Empty, layer: Layer = Layer.NORMAL): Facts =
        manager.factsOf(PathFact(base, path, tail, mark), exclusion, layer)
}

/** Frozen a80 summary/request protocol law fixture; no selected-engine claim. */
class HistoricalPipelineFixtures(index: Int = 1, limit: Int = 3,
                       val protocol: ProtocolSteps = ProtocolSteps.Inline) : AutoCloseable {
    val method = MethodAnalysisFixtures()
    val store = method.store
    val ap = method.manager
    val ops = method.ops
    val caller = method.key
    val callee = store.key(context = "callee")
    val records = method.records
    val config = method.config(index = index, L = limit)
    val storages = LinkedHashMap<MethodKey, SummaryStorage>()
    val staticFootprints = LinkedHashMap<CommonMethod, Run1StaticFootprint>()
    val deliveries = ArrayList<RunEvent.Delivery>()
    data class Summary(val caller: MethodKey, val part: Subscription, val publication: Publication, val member: Int)
    data class Native(val caller: MethodKey, val part: Subscription, val record: Record)
    data class View(val caller: MethodKey, val part: Subscription, val view: RecordLeafView, val nonSubsumable: Boolean = false)
    val summaries = ArrayList<Summary>()
    val native = ArrayList<Native>()
    val views = ArrayList<View>()
    var onSummary: ((Summary) -> Unit)? = null
    var onRecord: ((Native) -> Unit)? = null
    var onView: ((View) -> Unit)? = null
    var onPost: ((RunEvent.Delivery) -> Unit)? = null

    fun storage(key: MethodKey = callee): SummaryStorage = storages.getOrPut(key) {
        SummaryStorage(key, ap, ops, protocol)
    }

    val port = object : SubscriptionPort {
        override val config get() = this@HistoricalPipelineFixtures.config
        override val ops get() = this@HistoricalPipelineFixtures.ops
        override val steps get() = protocol
        override fun summaryStorage(key: MethodKey): SummaryStorage = storage(key)
        override fun staticFootprint(method: CommonMethod): Run1StaticFootprint? = staticFootprints[method]
        override fun applier(caller: MethodKey): SummaryApplier = object : SummaryApplier {
            override fun applySummary(part: Subscription, pub: Publication, member: Int) {
                val application = Summary(caller, part, pub, member)
                summaries += application
                onSummary?.invoke(application)
            }
            override fun applyRecord(part: Subscription, record: Record) {
                val application = Native(caller, part, record)
                native += application
                onRecord?.invoke(application)
            }
            override fun applyRecordView(part: Subscription, view: RecordLeafView, nonSubsumable: Boolean) {
                val application = View(caller, part, view, nonSubsumable)
                views += application
                onView?.invoke(application)
            }
        }
        override fun post(event: RunEvent.Delivery): Boolean {
            deliveries += event
            onPost?.invoke(event)
            return true
        }
    }
    val subscriptions = SubscriptionManager(port)

    fun subscription(added: Facts = store.fact(), premise: PremiseKey =
        if (added is FlowTree) ops.policy(added) else ap.zero,
                     callerLayer: Layer = Layer.NORMAL, call: Int = 1,
                     caller: MethodKey = this.caller, callee: MethodKey = this.callee,
                     zeroOnly: Boolean = false): Subscription =
        Subscription(callee, CallerRef(caller, premise, callerLayer, store.inst(call)), added.layer, added, zeroOnly)

    fun deliverAll() {
        while (deliveries.isNotEmpty()) {
            val event = deliveries.removeAt(0)
            subscriptions.onDelivery(event.callee, event.publications)
        }
    }

    override fun close() { subscriptions.freeze(); method.close() }
}

data class TestMark(val name: String, val owner: MarkGroupKey = MarkGroupKey.Model(name))

/** The same name/owner uniformity contract as production, without a JVM dependency. */
fun testDeclarations(vararg marks: TestMark): MarkDeclarations {
    val keys = linkedMapOf<String, FullKey>()
    val owners = linkedMapOf<String, MarkGroupKey>()
    val flags = linkedMapOf<MarkGroupKey, Boolean>()
    for ((name, owner) in marks) {
        val previousOwner = owners.putIfAbsent(name, owner)
        require(previousOwner == null || previousOwner == owner) { "Conflicting owners for $name" }
        val primitive = name.endsWith("%%primitive%%")
        val previousFlag = flags.putIfAbsent(owner, primitive)
        require(previousFlag == null || previousFlag == primitive) { "Mixed primitive tracking: $owner" }
        keys[name] = FullKey(encodeGroup(owner, primitive), name)
    }
    return FrozenMarkDeclarations(keys)
}

fun fixtureMarkDeclarations(names: Iterable<String>): MarkDeclarations =
    testDeclarations(*names.map(::TestMark).toTypedArray())
